text: The present moment is filled with joy and happiness. If you are attentive, you will see it.
Walk as if you are kissing the Earth with your feet.
Because you are alive, everything is possible.
Feelings come and go like clouds in a windy sky. Conscious breathing is my anchor.
No mud, no lotus.
Waking up this morning, I smile. Twenty-four brand new hours are before me.
To be beautiful means to be yourself. You don't need to be accepted by others. You need to accept yourself.
Hope is important because it can make the present moment less difficult to bear.
Be kind whenever possible. It is always possible.
My religion is very simple. My religion is kindness.
If you want others to be happy, practice compassion. If you want to be happy, practice compassion.
Sleep is the best meditation.
You are the sky. Everything else is just the weather.
Nothing ever goes away until it has taught us what we need to know.
Compassion is not a relationship between the healer and the wounded. It's a relationship between equals.
Start where you are.
In the beginner's mind there are many possibilities, but in the expert's there are few.
Each of you is perfect the way you are, and you can use a little improvement.
If you let go a little, you will have a little peace. If you let go a lot, you will have a lot of peace.
Do everything with a mind that lets go.
Looking for peace is like looking for a turtle with a mustache. Let go, and it comes looking for you.
Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by love. This is the eternal rule.
Better than a thousand hollow words is one word that brings peace.
Drop by drop is the water pot filled.
If your compassion does not include yourself, it is incomplete.
The boundary to what we can accept is the boundary to our freedom.
Vulnerability is the birthplace of innovation, creativity and change.
Courage starts with showing up and letting ourselves be seen.
Clear is kind. Unclear is unkind.
You can choose courage or you can choose comfort, but you cannot have both.
Owning our story and loving ourselves through that process is the bravest thing we'll ever do.
Connection is why we're here; it is what gives purpose and meaning to our lives.
Talk to yourself like you would to someone you love.
Empathy fuels connection. Sympathy drives disconnection.
Imperfections are not inadequacies; they are reminders that we're all in this together.
What we know matters, but who we are matters more.
If we share our story with someone who responds with empathy and understanding, shame can't survive.
Courage is contagious.
Stay awkward, brave and kind.
Strong back, soft front, wild heart.
People are hard to hate close up. Move in.
There is no innovation and creativity without failure. Period.
Integrity is choosing courage over comfort.
